name: facelogin
description: Autenticación únicamente por reconocimiento facial con plantillas cifradas y LSH

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:https: node scripts/ensure-dev-certs.mjs && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "FACELOGIN_HTTPS=1 npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
